question: Which treaty was signed on 17 July 2025 between the United Kingdom and Germany, marking their first bilateral treaty since the Second World War?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kensington Treaty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **United Kingdom** and **Germany** signed the **Kensington Treaty** on **17 July 2025**.
 
• This agreement marked the **first bilateral treaty** between the two countries since the end of the **Second World War**.
 
• The treaty focused on strengthening cooperation in areas such as:
 
 
• **Defence and security**
 
• **Trade and investment**
 
• **Technology and innovation**
 
• **Climate and energy cooperation**
 
 
 
• The agreement symbolized a major step toward enhancing strategic relations between the **UK** and **Germany** in the post-**Brexit** period.
 
• **Option-wise Analysis:**
 
 
• **Kensington Treaty** – UK-Germany bilateral treaty signed in 2025. **Correct**.
 
• **Lancaster House 2.0** – Related to defence cooperation terminology, not this treaty.
 
• **Northwood Declaration** – Not associated with the 2025 UK-Germany treaty.
 
• **Maastricht Treaty** – Signed in **1992**, establishing the **European Union (EU)**.
 
 
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Kensington Treaty.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Second World War** lasted from **1939 to 1945** and significantly shaped European diplomatic relations.
 
• **Germany** is Europe’s largest economy, while the **United Kingdom** remains a major global financial and military power.
 
• **Brexit** refers to the withdrawal of the United Kingdom from the **European Union** on **31 January 2020**.
 
• **Maastricht Treaty** was signed in **1992** in the Netherlands and formally created the **European Union**.
 
• Modern bilateral treaties often include cooperation in emerging sectors such as **cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, renewable energy, and defence technology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Kensington Treaty** reflects the growing importance of bilateral partnerships in Europe after Brexit.
 
• Questions related to **international treaties, global diplomacy, European affairs, and current international developments** are frequently asked in competitive examinations.
